annotations.title: Visits by channel, page and device

description: Analytics for a connected website, a window against the one before: visits, engagement and conversions; by channel (with weekly series), landing page and device; conversions by event and page. Later pages of a visit are not held. Another organization's or an unconnected site answers not found. Read-only.

after_from.description: First day of the later window.

after_to.description: Last day of the later window (same length as the earlier one).

before_from.description: Instead of days: first day of the earlier window (give all four).

before_to.description: Last day of the earlier window.

channel.description: An Analytics channel, e.g. Organic Search, Direct.

days.description: Window length in whole weeks of days (7, 14, … 182; default 28), ending on the latest day with data, against the same number of days before.

limit.description: How many landing pages and converting pages (default 10).

page.description: One page, exactly as webops_pages returns it.

name: webops_visits
title: Visits by channel, page and device
